The '''Siantide droids''' were [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[War Trust]] group, with [[Project Siantide|Siantide technology]]. The prototype was destroyed by [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] during his [[Destruction of the War Trust|hunt]] for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Faraire]].
